Hello,

I saw the Junior Graphic Designer opening at Bitmedia Labs and was drawn to your focus on high-performance digital advertising platforms used globally.

In my current role at Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable templates that reduced turnaround time. My work relies on strong typography, visual hierarchy, and efficient execution using Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, and AI-assisted workflows.

For an example of my digital marketing work, you can look at the social campaign for a fashion brand in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/, which delivered a 15% increase in follower engagement.

Could we take a 15-minute call to discuss how my background aligns with your digital advertising needs?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
